replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
About the lag people are complaining about.
Every update will decrease performance. They have done a lot about it in 1.8 and added stuff like VBO to help people. Some people get more FPS, some get less and you can't change that.

As for when, I don't know. Due to the DMCA stuff that happened with Bukkit and Spigot it will be really delayed. There is Sponge thats WIP but it will take some time.

But it will have to update at some point. If people like it or not the server will have to update or it will die as players would update their clients to play on other servers. The amount of players will drop a lot if the server doesn't update at some point.

If you have lag issues these might help:
  • Update Java (or use the new launcher that has java with it)
  • Update drivers
  • Install optifine
  • Mess around with the settings (render distance, VBOs etc.)
  • Close applications you are not using when playing
  • Check power saving (laptops)
Some stuff to clear:
  • Block hitting is still here but its changed. The animation mostly but its still here.
  • Don't complain about FPS drops as it happens with every update and will continue happening. The game is doing more stuff with each update (as theres new stuff in the game) so that will happen. Check above to improve performance.
Again, the server will have to update at some point otherwise the player amount would drop a lot. It would become outdated and would die out. You can complain as much as you want but it will have to happen at some point.
